sloka: तयोः पृथक्पृथग्भीमः शुश्रुवे तलनिस्वनः।प्रकम्पयन् जनं घोरो निर्घात इव दारुणः ।। ६.८९.३० ।।
transliteration: tayoḥ pṛthakpṛthagbhīmaḥ śuśruve talanisvanaḥ।prakampayan janaṁ ghoro nirghāta iva dāruṇaḥ ।। 6.89.30 ।।

translations.english: Both human and Rakshasa warriors fought an exceedingly frightening and dreadful fight over one another with agility without wasting a single arrow.
